thread:
**Issue #2578 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2578: Patch: retire the 240 golden games; the hotseat fixture and the parent-build diff stay
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it means
`crates/engine/tests/golden/games.jsonl` (5.8 MB, 240 games) was the oracle for the TypeScript → Rust port (SURFACE §13). The TS engine is gone, and its decks are dealt from the live shipped pool, so nearly every card PR re-blesses the whole file: 26 re-blesses between Oct 27 and Oct 31 (the shallow clone's whole history), with bot merges resolving conflicts on it (#2570 lists some). A snapshot re-blessed on almost every gameplay PR proves nothing on those PRs. The cross-build check it still offers, "this branch plays like its base", is already done better by `golden record` + `golden check --file` on the parent build (`luau diff --parent-bin`, `classify --parent-bin`), measured against the current base with nothing committed.

The owner chose this over pinning the decks (#2570, closed as not planned).

## Do
- Delete `crates/engine/tests/golden/games.jsonl`.
- **Keep** `crates/engine/tests/golden.rs` as a binary named `golden` that checks the hotseat fixture (`01-hotseat-full-game.json` folds to `HOTSEAT_HASH`) and `pre-equip-log.json`. Drop the 240-game shards. `ci.yml`'s `engine golden` group runs `--test golden`, and this issue may not change `.github/`, so the binary must stay and pass.
- **Keep** `testkit::golden` (`replay_game`, `hashed_state_text`, `view_texts`, `Mismatch`, the hotseat items). `rules/rule_benders.rs`, `golden check --file` and `classify` use them.
- `cargo jackioh golden`:
  - `check` with no `--file` checks the hotseat fixture only and exits 0 when it holds. `super.yml`'s daily `golden check` job runs it, so it must keep passing.
  - `check --file` and `record` stay as they are (`luau diff` and `classify` use them).
  - `bless` goes away. The owner approved removing it here (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Make `golden bless` fail with a message that points to `golden record`.
- `crates/tools/src/luau.rs`: `luau bench` times "one golden step" from `GAMES_PATH`. Have it record a fixed handful of seeds with `record_seeds` into a temp file under `target/` and time those instead. `BENCH_BUDGETS` stay.
- `crates/tools/tests/golden.rs`: it doctors a copy of `games.jsonl`. Have it doctor a file `golden record` writes instead.
- Rulings whose `proven_in` lists `crates/engine/tests/golden.rs`, **R781000** (an old log's `magnetic` flag folds as `equip`) and **R1846003** (card metrics under a fold): give each a focused proving test (an engine rules test, or a small fixture log under `crates/engine/tests/fixtures/`), named per CLAUDE.md rule 3, and update `proven_in`. Reword R2511001's mention of "the golden tool's forcing" only if it stops being true (forcing stays in `record`). Any new ruling goes in this issue's block, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.
- Docs that describe the 240 games or `bless`: `crates/engine/README.md` (the `golden` row), `crates/tools/README.md` (`golden` rows, `luau bench`), `BUILD.md` (around lines 67 and 1490–1504, and the "golden traces re-blessed" step of a set release around 1169), `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` (the "re-record with `golden bless`" step, about lines 237–240), `docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` §13 (mark it historical), and the header comments in `golden.rs`, `testkit/golden.rs` and `testkit/mod.rs`.
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh`: keep `crates/engine/tests/golden/*` mapped to e2e (the hotseat fixture stays). Update its header comments that describe the golden replay.
- `apps/web/src/net/vercel-ignore.test.ts:164` lists `crates/engine/tests/golden/games.jsonl` as an example path. Swap it for a file that still exists if the test needs one.

## Not in this issue (human, forbidden paths for the bot)
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (comments around lines 40, 227–234, 288–295) and `super.yml` (header line 9, the `golden` job at 202–224) still describe the 240 traces. Both keep working after this change; a person tidies the wording and job names later.
- `bot/go/internal/resolve/resolve.go` and `bot/go/tests/resolve_test.go` resolve `games.jsonl` conflicts. That path becomes dead; a person removes it.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `games.jsonl` is gone, and no file outside `.github/` and `bot/` names it.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test golden` passes: the hotseat fixture still folds to `972f5b85` (unchanged).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh golden check` exits 0. `golden record --seeds 1..5 --out <f>` followed by `golden check --file <f>` passes, and the same file with one hash changed fails, naming the seed and step (the tools test).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh luau bench` still runs and reports a golden-step time.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <path>` still runs its forced-game stage.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes: R781000 and R1846003 are proven by their new tests.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` pass.

## Risks
- What we lose: an accidental behaviour change on a "no gameplay change" PR is no longer caught for free unless someone runs `classify`/`luau diff` against the parent. `rust (classify)` already runs on every PR; check whether its stage 2 needs `--parent-bin` in CI, and if it does, note it for the human follow-up above rather than editing `.github/`.
- Fuzz (`cargo jackioh fuzz`) keeps the determinism checks: every game is folded back to its live hash. Those never depended on the golden file.
```
